Name: JP's Artdew Valley Vol XII - Fantasy Terrariums
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][i][size=6][color=#00ffff][u][center][b]Artdew Valley Vol XII[/b][/center]
[/u][/color][/size][/i]
[color=#ff00ff][size=5][i][b]Because locking a bird in a cage is cruel... Let's lock up more diversity![/b][/i][/size][/color]


[size=4][i]This mod consists of 12 volumes so far, this being the twelfth of them. [/i][/size][size=4][i]This volume focuses on 15 terrariums (I broke the streak of 30, how bad), many of which have unusual designs, and I call them fantasy because otherwise they are too unusual to be normal.[/i][/size][size=4][i]
[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]You can get all the Terrariums at [color=#00ff00]Robin's store[/color] for the modest price of 1000g each.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]You will find 3 terrariums available per day, on [color=#00ff00]Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays[/color]. During that time, you will be able to obtain all 15 terrariums available in this volume.[/size]
[*][size=4]Keep in mind that many are quite large and take up considerable space, but if you have room, they can still be placed indoors.[/size]
[*][size=4]They don't have any special interactions nor animations, they're just decorations, how sad :'([/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size]
[color=#00ffff][size=5]Not much more to add, I hope you enjoy it![/size][/color]
[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]
Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]
